IBCIBC Recommendation

Aloha.nutrition

As an IBCLC lactation consultant who works with a
wide range of breastfeeding families, I'm always
looking for tools that support parents in meeting
their feeding goals.One pump I personally use and
recommend is the Momcozy M9, particularly for
working parents who need flexibility and discretion
while pumping.

Mamashaktiprenatal

As a lactation counselor and a mom who's been
there, I can confidently say the Momcozy V1 Pro
and M9 MobileFlow breast pumps are absolute
game changers for pumping parents.These aren't
just pumps, in my opinion, they're freedom.

Loyallactation

This pump is a game-changer for moms returning
to work. It's quiet,hands-free,and portable,making
it ideal for pumping on the go or during short
breaks without having to hook up to a traditional,
wall-powered pump. For a mom who has already
built a solid supply and needs a convenient way to
maintain it through out the workday, the Momcozy
M9 is a strong, affordable solution.
